newsitems.title: Find The Needle Reaches TOP 3 Most Played Demos on Steam!
newsitems.author: FindTheNeedleDev
newsitems.contents: FIND THE NEEDLE JUST REACHED TOP 3 MOST PLAYED DEMOS ON STEAM 🌾Top 10 felt unbelievable.Then Top 5.Now somehow we are in the Top 3.We are putting an insane amount of time, energy and passion into Find The Needle every single day.Countless hours spent playing Factorio and Satisfactory taught us what makes automation games so satisfying, and now we are trying to turn everything we love about that genre into something much stranger.A game where you build an entire factory just to find a few needles in an absurd amount of hay.Our goal is simple:Make one of the weirdest and most amazing games we possibly can.Thank you to everyone playing, wishlisting, reporting bugs 🐞 and helping us shape the game. ❤️This is just one milestone in a much bigger journey.There is still so much we want to build, improve and completely overdo.Thank you for being here while we turn this strange idea into something real. ❤️Join the community: Discord“Reality is the only thing that’s real.” -James Halliday

newsitems.title: Find The Needle Reaches TOP 5 Most Played Demos on Steam!
newsitems.author: FindTheNeedleDev
newsitems.contents: 🌾 FIND THE NEEDLE IS NOW IN THE TOP 5 MOST PLAYED DEMOS ON STEAM! 🌾A few days ago we were celebrating Top 10.Now we're somehow in the Top 5.I genuinely did not expect Find The Needle to get this much attention so quickly.Thank you to everyone who played the demo, wishlisted the game, sent feedback, reported bugs, made videos, shared screenshots and told their friends about it.We are still working on the game every day, fixing things and adding new content. There is still a lot we want to do before release.Seeing so many people playing something we've spent so much time building is an incredible feeling.Thank you for being part of this. ❤️🌾We're only getting started.Join Our Discord “Speed has never killed anyone. Suddenly becoming stationary, that's what gets you.”Jeremy Clarkson

newsitems.title: Find The Needle Demo V8
newsitems.author: animatemesh
newsitems.contents: The conveyor at the Hay Sell Stand will snap from now onYou can now decide if you want conveyors to snap or not. Press F to activate No Snap ModePressing E on a power pole will now let you shut down the whole electricity networkVacuum Yard price reduced by 80%Added a power network notification VFX when power drops below the required thresholdHigher jump height by defaultComplete rework of the conveyor belt system. Conveyors will snap much easier now and have automatic pathfinding, making them much easier to work withAdded new splitter and joiner types: U-Splitters and U-JoinersAdded in-game tips that will show instead of the "Find The Needle Demo V8" textLoose hay on the ground will now turn into hay tufts to improve FPSThe Pellet Disc Machine now has resource indicators like "BRICKS" and "HAY"And many more bug fixes
